data.chunk_text:  Low to moderate Probability of Heat Wave conditions likely during the week 2 over some parts of Odisha, Jharkhand, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, & north Coastal Andhra Pradesh. Appreciably above normal (+3.1 to +5.0°C) maximum temperatures are likely over some parts of Odisha, north Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Jharkhand, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Gangetic West Bengal and East Uttar Pradesh; normal to above-normal  maximum  temperatures  ((+1.6  to  +3.0°C)  are  likely  over  most  parts  of  Northwest India,  and  many  parts  of  the  East  &  Northeast,  South  and  Western  parts  of  India.  Below-normal weekly maximum temperatures are likely in isolated places over the rest of the country.
